title: Civil Engineering Technologists and Technicians
description: Apply theory and principles of civil engineering in planning, designing, and overseeing construction and maintenance of structures and facilities under the direction of engineering staff or physical scientists.

tasks.text: Calculate dimensions, square footage, profile and component specifications, and material quantities, using calculator or computer.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Estimates from specs; human validates assumptions and risk

dwas.name: Estimate technical or resource requirements for development or production projects.

tasks.text: Read and review project blueprints and structural specifications to determine dimensions of structure or system and material requirements.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Review technical docs to plan work

dwas.name: Review technical documents to plan work.

tasks.text: Draft detailed dimensional drawings and design layouts for projects to ensure conformance to specifications.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Civil drawings need licensed engineering judgment

dwas.name: Create graphical representations of civil structures.

tasks.text: Confer with supervisor to determine project details such as plan preparation, acceptance testing, and evaluation of field conditions.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Conferring with technical staff on plans is relational work

dwas.name: Confer with technical personnel to prepare designs or operational plans.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Analyze proposed site factors and design maps, graphs, tracings, and diagrams to illustrate findings.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Generates maps; cartographic accuracy and standards human

tasks.text: Prepare reports and document project activities and data.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Generate operational reports from structured data

tasks.text: Report maintenance problems occurring at project site to supervisor and negotiate changes to resolve system conflicts.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Design problem conferral aided; accountability stays human

dwas.name: Confer with other personnel to resolve design or operational problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Inspect project site and evaluate contractor work to detect design malfunctions and ensure conformance to design specifications and applicable codes.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical site verification against specs is human

dwas.name: Inspect facilities or sites to determine if they meet specifications or standards.

tasks.text: Conduct materials test and analysis, using tools and equipment and applying engineering knowledge.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Material characteristic testing needs physical instruments

dwas.name: Test characteristics of materials or structures.

tasks.text: Develop plans and estimate costs for installation of systems, utilization of facilities, or construction of structures.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Detailed work plans drafted from specifications

dwas.name: Estimate operational costs.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Develop project budgets by estimating the cost of project activities.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Project budgets drafted by AI, human reviews

tasks.text: Plan and conduct field surveys to locate new sites and analyze details of project sites.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Field survey of land/water bodies

dwas.name: Survey land or bodies of water to measure or determine features.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Respond to public suggestions and complaints.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Written correspondence to customers is largely automatable

dwas.name: Respond to customer problems or complaints.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

dwas.name: Correspond with customers to answer questions or resolve complaints.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Negotiate with contractors on prices for new contracts or modifications to existing contracts.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Price negotiation needs live give-and-take

dwas.name: Negotiate prices or other sales terms.
dwas.gwa_name: Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others

emerging_tasks.task: Operate drones for site surveying and inspection, providing detailed aerial views of project sites.
